## 2. Flagship System Architectures & Production Proofs

### Case Study 1: OmniDimension - Enterprise Voice AI & Automated QA (1,000,000+ Calls)
- **Role:** Forward Deployed Engineer (Feb 2026 - Oct 2026) / Software Engineer - GenAI (Nov 2025 - Feb 2026)
- **Problem:** Enterprise healthcare and e-commerce voice campaigns experienced 1,850ms+ awkward conversational dead-air during LLM/CRM lookups, while manual QA teams could audit <1% of call recordings against strict clinical SOPs.
- **Architecture & Solution:**
  1. **Telephony & Streaming STT:** Tuned Twilio/Ozonetel/Exotel bi-directional WebSockets and custom VAD endpointing across Deepgram/Soniox/Speechmatics to cut end-of-thought detection by 250ms.
  2. **Dynamic Contextual Filler Engine:** Built a <120ms micro-intent filler that plays context-aware conversational audio while the Voice AI pipeline queries RAG and CRM lookups in parallel - reducing perceived latency to ~380ms TTFA.
  3. **Enterprise CRM & Scheduling Sync:** Engineered bidirectional integrations with Odoo and LeadSquared CRMs, generating 50+ qualified patient consultations in the first month.
  4. **Automated LLM SOP Compliance Pipeline:** Audited 100% of call recordings asynchronously against proprietary clinical and operational scoring matrices.

### Case Study 2: MedSearch AI & K-Search - Empirical MLflow Medical RAG Evaluation Pipeline
- **Repository & Benchmark Report:** https://github.com/md-ziauddin/rag_evaluation_pipeline/commit/c4af8e04fe5793619b37927639a270f745ed8740
- **Infrastructure:** PubMedQA (`pqa_labeled`), Qdrant (`v1.12.4`), AWS Bedrock (`amazon.titan-embed-text-v2:0` 1,024-dim + `us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929-v1:0`), LangGraph (Agentic vs Linear RAG), BM25 + RRF ($k=60$), and MLflow (`v2.17.2`).
- **Empirical Findings:**
  - **Experiment 1 (100 Docs, ~500 Chunks, 15 Queries):** Dense retrieval achieved `1.1417` NDCG@10 and `0.4989` MRR@10 (`~508ms/query`), while Dense + Agentic achieved `0.8094` Answer Relevance and `0.3774` Faithfulness. Naive 50/50 BM25 + Dense fusion dropped MRR@10 to `0.3400` due to generic biomedical token collisions.
  - **Experiment 2 Scale Sweep (300 Docs, ~1,500 Chunks, 30 Queries):** Dense retrieval achieved `0.9471` NDCG@10 and `0.4450` MRR@10 (`~251ms/query`). Under noisy hybrid search, the self-correcting **LangGraph Agentic relevance grader** caught lexical false positives, boosting Hybrid NDCG@10 from `0.5587` to `0.6441` (`+15.3%`) and MRR@10 from `0.2583` to `0.2922` (`+13.1%`) at `~246ms/query`.

### Case Study 3: Growwth Partners & RyzUp Sheets - Real-Time Fintech & React GAS Runtime
- **Role:** Senior Software Engineer (Jul 2024 - Nov 2025)
- **Problem:** Financial analysts faced 2.4s+ polling delays on the web platform and fragmented Google Sheets workflows.
- **Architecture & Solution:**
  - Replaced REST polling with multiplexed bidirectional WebSockets + Redis Pub/Sub, reducing application latency by 90% (2,400ms to 240ms) and accelerating release velocity by 40%.
  - Created a standardized React Google Apps Script (GAS) framework powering RyzUp Sheets (`=RYZUP_AI()`, `=RYZUP_FORECAST()`, `=RYZUP_AUDIT()`) and mentored 4 junior engineers.

### Case Study 4: Articulate AI & High-Throughput Backend Primitives
- **Architecture & Solution:**
  - **Articulate AI:** Real-time voice mock interview platform built with Turborepo, Next.js, Nest.js WebRTC signaling gateway, Supabase Auth/PostgreSQL, and Google Gemini Live API.
  - **Sub-Millisecond Shortlink & Telemetry Engine:** Fastify + AJV pre-compiled schemas + Sqids bijective encoding + Redis write-through cache (0.42ms hit latency) + non-blocking analytics sink.
